name: Pill Navbar
summary: A floating content-width pill top bar with a stroke-drawn logo and logo hover menu, hover-wash nav items, multi-column mega dropdowns, icon quick-action tools with tooltips, and an 'on this page' mode that folds the nav into a section chip with progress and a section menu on scroll; collapses into a Menu/Close panel on narrow screens.
useWhen: A marketing site wants a floating, rounded header with rich product dropdowns
Dropdowns need grouped columns of icon, title and description links with hover intent and arrow-key navigation
A long page wants the header to fold into a current-section tracker with jump links
avoidWhen: A full-width classic top bar fits better; use marketing/product-navbar
An app shell needs persistent navigation; use a sidebar from app-interface
